summary.en: A card hangs near the camera, drops with an accelerating ease-in and lands with a ring, shards, a flash and a shake.
summary.zh: 卡片悬在镜头前，加速砸进自己的位置；落点那一帧冲击环、碎片、白闪和震屏同时起。

fits: A heavy card landing: the headline number, the result, the one feature that matters; the slot drop when the page already has neighbours.
notFor: More than two landings a film; calm, editorial or paper styles; text that must be read while it falls.

intent.en: The card lands with weight: the viewer feels it is heavy, and in the slot drop sees the force travel to its neighbours.
intent.zh: 卡片带着重量砸下：观众感到它很重；slot 式还能看见冲击力传到邻居身上。

content.en: One card in the scene (its rect), usually a headline number or result; for slot, the rects of its neighbours already on the page.
content.zh: 场景里的一张卡（给出位置框），通常是大数字或结果；slot 式还要给出页面上已在场的邻卡位置。

fits.zh: 一张有分量的卡落地：大数字、结果、最要紧的那个功能；页面上已有邻卡时用 slot 落位。

notFor.zh: 一支片超过两次落地；安静、编辑感或纸墨风格（用 plate-slip）；下落途中就要读的字。

pairs.note: the number on the landed card can roll to its value

en: At most two slams a film counting perspective-fling; one source of shake per shot.
In slot, the neighbours must have been still for at least 15 frames before they are knocked, or the cause is lost.
The ring needs contrast: a saturated ring over a white pressure disc on light grounds, a white core with a coloured glow on dark (set dark).
The landing wants a boom on the same frame; silent, the burst reads as a twitch.
zh: 连同 perspective-fling 全片砸入最多两次；一个镜头只有一个震源。
slot 式的邻卡要先静止至少 15 帧再被撞开，否则看不出因果。
冲击环要有反差：浅底上用饱和色环配白色压力盘，深底上用白芯加色辉（开 dark）。
落地帧要同帧配音爆，无声的三件套读作抽搐。

upstream.name: 比分砸入
upstream.summary: 卡从 scale 2.5/rotate 5° 六帧 Easing.in(quad) 砸落，落点帧圆环扩散+尘点飞散+震屏同帧
upstream.use: 主角卡/KPI 卡的重拳入场；impact-feedback 管落位后的反馈，本卡管入场本身就是冲击

upstream.name: 冲击爆点套件
upstream.summary: B 三件套 + 冲击波前沿按半径-距离精算扫过邻卡帧，邻卡外推 30px + rotate ±3° 阻尼弹回
upstream.use: 主角卡/KPI 卡的重拳入场；impact-feedback 管落位后的反馈，本卡管入场本身就是冲击

upstream.name: 连招计数
upstream.summary: 三卡接连砸入，每命中 = 顿帧 2f + 伤害数字上浮 + ×N 计数跳字逐次加码
upstream.use: 元素落位/撞击的"命中一瞬"——给砸入、撞停加游戏级手感；按强度阶梯选式

overlaps.note: the same weight class on another axis: flung in from the side with a perspective snap
cards set down on a stack, no impact
the hit after a crash zoom; a film takes one of the two as its peak
